subject: Mythology
title: Horoscopes: Astrology's Mythological Roots
description: One-minute skill: Horoscopes: Astrology's Mythological Roots.

hook.text: One in four Americans checks their horoscope regularly. Every zodiac sign is a character from Greek mythology.

buildup.text: Aries is the golden ram. Leo is the Nemean lion slain by Hercules. Virgo is linked to Persephone, underworld queen.

discovery.text: Babylonians created the zodiac 2,500 years ago, but Greeks added the mythological stories that made each sign memorable.

twist.text: Astronomers note that constellations have shifted so much that zodiac signs no longer match actual star positions.

climax.text: Despite having no scientific basis, astrology is a $12 billion global industry fueled by mythological storytelling.

punchline.text: Greek mythology is a billion-dollar industry disguised as a personality quiz.

quiz.question: Who originally created the zodiac signs used in astrology?
options: Ancient Greek philosophers at the Academy in Athens
Babylonians created the zodiac; Greeks added the mythological stories
Egyptian priests who studied the stars at the Great Pyramids
